tonight.headline: Waivers cleared in your favour — Metcalf and Diggs both landed
body: Bad news first: your bench now holds three bye players — Allen, Tuten and Diggs — so if a starter falls between now and Sunday, the only cover is Kamara at running back and Metcalf at receiver.

The overnight moves landed: Diggs claimed for McLaurin, Metcalf added free for Allgeier, Broncos D/ST for the Patriots. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 130.8 against JuiceJam's 90.2, a 72% favourite on ESPN. Nothing to do today.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: JuiceJam start James Cook on a bye and carry Jacobs and Montgomery on the bench, both in doubt. They need about 40 points of swing; a Warren or Jefferson injury on this week's reports is the only thing on your side that moves it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Green Bay clearing Josh Jacobs (practising from Wednesday, status TBD — Packers.com 19 Oct) and JuiceJam starting him for Cook — about 12.7 back on their side.

whatWentWrong.title: The claim went to Diggs, not Metcalf — and it still worked
whatWentWrong.lead: Metcalf cleared unclaimed and was added free at 07:55Z; the price was Allgeier.

case.label: What happened
case.body: At 07:41Z the waiver run gave AVIATO Stefon Diggs for Terry McLaurin and the Broncos D/ST for the Patriots. Metcalf went unclaimed and was added as a free agent fourteen minutes later, dropping Tyler Allgeier (activity log).

case.label: What it leaves
case.body: Both receivers last night's brief wanted, but three bye players on the bench in Week 7 — no in-week cover beyond Kamara and Metcalf. Nothing to do about it before Sunday; the slots changed today and are closed under the churn rule.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A starter is ruled out before Sunday and neither Kamara nor Metcalf can cover his slot — then carrying Diggs on a bye cost a lineup spot.

whatWentWrong.title: Week 6 was won with 11.0 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Kamara's 14.9 sat behind Allgeier's 5.8 and Love's 20.2 behind Allen's 18.3 — both projection calls, neither an override.

case.label: The numbers
case.body: 122.6 to 82.94 over Bok-aneers; best possible lineup 133.6 (week-6 archive, recomputed this run).

case.label: The lesson
case.body: Both were projection calls that lost. The fix is not to override — it is to set the lineup every week, which is done for Week 7: the lineup as set is the projection lineup.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Week 7 lineup set by projection leaves more than 15 points on the bench (archive).
